info.title: readmd — terminal Markdown viewer
info.description: A terminal-first, feature-rich Markdown viewer with live reload, search, [[_TOC_]], mermaid and D2 diagrams, and an optional browser mode.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: readmd — a terminal-first Markdown viewer with live reload, search, [[_TOC_]], mermaid and D2 diagrams, and an optional browser mode.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --browser
options.description: Open in the browser instead of the terminal (full-fidelity mermaid/D2/math). [default: False]

options.name: --port
options.description: Port for browser mode (0 = pick a free port). [default: 0]

options.name: --no-open
options.description: In browser mode, start the server but don't launch a browser. [default: False]

options.name: --best-effort
options.description: Terminal mode: skip the headless-browser download; mermaid diagrams open in the browser instead. [default: False]

options.name: --theme
options.description: Color theme: dark, light, auto, a built-in name (see `readmd themes`: nord, dracula, …) or a custom theme from your config (default: auto).

options.name: --background
options.description: Background fill: 'solid' paints a solid themed background (overrides terminal transparency); 'terminal' lets the terminal background show through.

options.name: --d2-path
options.description: Explicit path to the d2 executable (defaults to 'd2' on PATH).

options.name: --export
options.description: Export to a self-contained file and exit. The format is chosen from the extension: .html (default) or .pdf.

options.name: --print
options.description: Render to stdout and exit (plain text, or ANSI when stdout is a terminal). Implied when stdout is redirected to a pipe or file. [default: False]

options.name: --root
options.description: Directory that local links and images may reach (default: the document's folder). Lets ../sibling.md links resolve inside a larger wiki.

options.name: --color
options.description: Colour depth: auto (default: detect; honours NO_COLOR/FORCE_COLOR), always/truecolor, 256, 16, or never. For --print, 'always' forces ANSI even when piped (e.g. `| less -R`).

options.name: --width
options.description: Maximum reading width in columns (content is centred when the terminal is wider); also the wrap width for --print. Default: full width (config: maxWidth).

options.name: --graphics
options.description: Inline image protocol: auto (default: detect via terminal queries), sixel, kitty, iterm2, half-block, or none.

options.name: --ascii
options.description: Use plain ASCII glyphs instead of box drawing and symbols (for fonts/terminals without them, or clean piped text). [default: False]

options.name: --offline
options.description: Never touch the network: remote images are not fetched and no online diagram service is used. [default: False]

options.name: --no-watch
options.description: Don't live-reload when the file changes (W toggles it at runtime). [default: False]

options.name: --slides
options.description: Presentation mode: one slide per '---' / <!-- slide -->, with <!-- pause --> reveals and <!-- notes --> speaker notes (Ctrl+S toggles at runtime). [default: False]

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

arguments.name: FILE
arguments.description: Markdown file(s) to view: paths, globs (docs/**/*.md), a directory (opens a file picker), '-' for stdin, an https:// URL, or gh:owner/repo[@ref][/path].

commands.name: completions
commands.description: Print a shell completion script to stdout.

arguments.name: SHELL
arguments.description: Shell to generate completions for: bash, zsh, pwsh, or fish.

commands.name: man
commands.description: Print a man page (troff) to stdout.

commands.name: install-pdf
commands.description: Download the headless browser used for high-quality PDF export (one-time, ~100 MB). Requires Node.js on PATH.

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Check this machine: terminal capabilities, colour depth, config files, diagram tools, PDF export, clipboard.

options.name: --no-probe
options.description: Skip the live terminal interrogation (DA1/kitty/OSC 11 queries). [default: False]

options.name: --offline
options.description: Never touch the network: remote images are not fetched and no online diagram service is used. [default: False]

options.name: --ascii
options.description: Use plain ASCII glyphs instead of box drawing and symbols (for fonts/terminals without them, or clean piped text). [default: False]

commands.name: themes
commands.description: List the available colour themes (built-in and from your config) with swatches.

options.name: --plain
options.description: No colour swatches; print hex values instead. [default: False]

options.name: --sample
options.description: Heading text used in the sample line.

commands.name: config
commands.description: Inspect, create or validate readmd's configuration files.

commands.name: path
commands.description: Show where readmd reads configuration from (user file, project file, state).

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Print only the user config path. [default: False]

commands.name: init
commands.description: Write a commented starter config file.

options.name: --project
options.description: Create a project-level .readmd.json in the current directory instead of the user config. [default: False]

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite an existing file. [default: False]

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Parse a config file and report unknown keys, bad values, invalid colours and key chords.

arguments.name: FILE
arguments.description: Config file to check (default: the user config and any project .readmd.json).

commands.name: schema
commands.description: Print the JSON Schema for the config file (for editor validation).
